title: Set Matrix Zeroes
statement: Given an m × n matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0 in place. Do this without using extra space for tracking (beyond a constant amount).

visibleExamples.explanation: After the function modifies matrix in-place, it becomes [[1, 0, 1], [0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 1]]. The element at (1,1) is 0, so row 1 and column 1 are zeroed.
After modification: [[0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 4, 5, 0], [0, 3, 1, 0]]. Rows 0 and columns 0, 3 are zeroed.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return type are JSON-representable (list[list[int]] and None).
